Apartamenti eshte Mundesi shume e mire investimi!!!
Ndodhet ne nje zonë të qetë e cila i ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare.
title_en: For sale, Apartment 1+1+2 blk, Sauk, Porta e Re Complex, 127,000 Euro

The apartment is in the stage of laying parquet and is ready for furnishing. The entrance is organized in a spacious living room where there is access to one of the balconies, the kitchen, 1 large bedroom which also has access to the balcony and the toilet. The apartment is a very good investment opportunity!!! It is located in a quiet area that offers all the necessary facilities. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency.
